data.name: Dashboard.Command.Error
data.value: The recovery session operation could not be completed.

data.name: Dashboard.State.Locked
data.value: Unlock the recovery vault to load the session dashboard.

data.name: Dashboard.State.Empty.Message
data.value: Use the suggested local name or edit it. You may add one optional recovery-channel warning; it does not detect or prove a compromise.

data.name: Dashboard.State.Corrupted.Title
data.value: Session record could not be loaded

data.name: Dashboard.State.Corrupted.Message
data.value: The encrypted session record is missing required data or failed integrity-safe parsing. It was not overwritten.

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.Indicators.Title
data.value: Does a primary recovery channel need immediate attention?

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.Indicators.Help
data.value: Possible control of a primary email or recovery channel shows an immediate advisory. Record account-specific access later so unpwn can choose a recovery approach safely. This answer does not prove a compromise.

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.Indicator.CompromisedRecovery
data.value: A primary email or recovery channel may be under someone else's control

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.SecurityWarning
data.value: The optional guidance warning is stored in the encrypted vault. It changes recommendations only.

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.Acknowledge
data.value: I understand that this warning guides priorities and does not prove that an account or device was compromised.

data.name: Dashboard.Intake.SkipHint
data.value: This warning is optional. Leave it unchecked when it does not apply.

data.name: Dashboard.Emergency.Message
data.value: Your answers indicate that a primary recovery channel or critical access may need immediate attention. This is an advisory priority, not an automated detection result.

data.name: Dashboard.Progress.Disclaimer
data.value: Progress is not a security verdict. Lost access, blockers, failures, and unresolved risks remain visible separately.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ImportAccounts
data.value: Import or add accounts so unpwn can suggest simple recovery categories.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.SecureRecoveryChannel
data.value: Review and secure the primary email or recovery channel before the remaining accounts.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.RestoreCriticalAccess
data.value: Restore access to the critical account before continuing with the remaining accounts.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ResolveCriticalBlocker
data.value: Resolve the recorded blocker or failure on the critical account.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.AddressUnresolvedRisk
data.value: Review the unresolved risk and record the next safe action.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ExportGeneratedCredentials
data.value: Export generated credentials to an established password manager and confirm cleanup.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ReviewCriticalAccount
data.value: Review the next critical account and its required recovery actions.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ReviewNextAccount
data.value: Continue with the next account allowed by the persisted recovery order.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ResumeSession
data.value: Resume the paused session before changing recovery state.

data.name: Dashboard.Recommendation.ArchivedSession
data.value: This session is archived and no longer accepts recovery-state changes.

data.name: Dashboard.Archive.Confirmation.Consequence
data.value: The session remains encrypted and readable, but recovery-state changes will stop. This does not mark accounts as secure or complete.

data.name: Dashboard.Validation.AcknowledgementRequired
data.value: Confirm the security warning before creating the session.

data.name: Dashboard.Validation.InvalidInput
data.value: Review the session name and guidance acknowledgement.

data.name: Dashboard.Validation.Corrupted
data.value: The existing session record is corrupted and was not replaced.

data.name: Dashboard.Validation.Conflict
data.value: The recovery session changed or is not in the required lifecycle state.

data.name: Dashboard.Validation.PersistenceFailure
data.value: The encrypted recovery session could not be saved.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Locked.Message
data.value: No session or incident data is available while the vault is locked.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Loading.Message
data.value: Reading the encrypted session record from the current vault.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Empty.Message
data.value: Create a session and optionally adjust recovery-channel priority.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Corrupted.Message
data.value: The encrypted record could not be parsed safely and was left unchanged.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Active.Message
data.value: The recommended next task and any work that still needs attention are shown below.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Paused.Message
data.value: Resume the session before changing recovery state.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Archived.Message
data.value: The encrypted record remains available for review, but state changes are disabled.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Emergency.Message
data.value: The incident answers create an advisory priority. They do not prove that an account or device was compromised.

data.name: Dashboard.Status.Created.Message
data.value: The encrypted session and incident indicators were saved. Use the recommended next step below.
